title: orders.orders_export
description: Cursor-paged snapshot of orders (the source_of_truth shape a composite projects from, e.g. orders per seller). Output: {rows: [{order_id, number, user_id, status, payment_status, currency, total, placed_at, lines: [{purchasable_type, purchasable_key, quantity, unit_price, seller_id}], seq}], cursor: str|null, total: int}. No contact or address.
